title: “Tú Ya Sabes” (You Already Know)
style: [Style of music: upbeat Miami Spanglish reggaeton pop rap fusion, 128 BPM, energetic male rapper with smooth female harmonies and group chants, Latin trap beats mixed with pop drops, fun educational vibe, heavy bass, claps, brass hits, tropical percussion, feel-good summer Miami party energy, bilingual flow, catchy hooks, professional studio mix]
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey amigo, tú ya sabes… you already know!
Spanish y English are twins, ¡vamos let’s go!
Cognates everywhere, no need to translate,
You already speak both – now let’s celebrate!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes, you already know!
Spanish y English are like twins, ¡vamos, let’s go!
Animal es animal, hospital es hospital,
Doctor, familia, música – it’s all so natural!
Idea es idea, flexible mind,
Important, perfecto, color in the air – you’ll find!
No problema, información, atención,
You know more than you think, ¡ahora sing it again!

[Verse 1]
En el hospital the doctor dice “no problema”,
With información y atención we solve la situación.
La familia together, color en el aire,
Important decisión, perfecto education everywhere!
Action y reaction, nation to nation,
Celebrate life, it’s easy, no frustration!
Flexible, posible, positive attraction,
You thought you only spoke English, but that’s an illusion!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes, you already know!
Spanish y English are like twins, ¡vamos, let’s go!
Doctor, familia, música, color,
Hospital, animal, idea – it’s all yours!

[Verse 2]
En la oficina the computer is computadora,
Internet, telephone, radio y televisión.
Restaurant, hotel, bank es banco,
Automóvil in the street, let’s go!
Education, information, communication,
Nation to nation, positive vibration.
Perfecto plan, important mission,
You already know Spanish in every position!

[Bridge – half rap, half sung]
Wait… you thought it was hard? Nah, it’s easy flow,
Cognates connect us, watch the language grow.
From Miami to Madrid, from New York to Bogotá,
One word, two languages – that’s the Spanglish law!
¡Familia! ¡Doctor! ¡Acción! ¡Educación!
You already speak both – feel the connection!

[Verse 3]
Música playing, positive reaction,
Celebrate together, no separation.
Flexible mind, possible dream,
Important moment, perfect team!
Color, idea, hospital, nation,
Doctor, family, attention, education.
No problema, información for all,
You know more Spanish than you recall!

[Verse 4]
En el restaurant the menu is menú,
Hotel reservation, bank account too.
Automóvil driving, radio on blast,
Televisión showing the future so fast.
Internet connects us, telephone rings,
Computer typing, everything sings!
Flexible schedule, possible vacation,
You already know – it’s pure celebration!

[Chorus – bigger, group vocals]
Tú ya sabes, you already know!
Spanish y English are like twins, ¡vamos, let’s go!
Animal es animal, hospital es hospital,
Doctor, familia, música – it’s all so natural!
Idea es idea, flexible mind,
Important, perfecto, color in the air – you’ll find!
¡Familia, hospital, doctor, color!
You know more than you think – now sing it some more!

[Outro – chant style, fade with claps]
Tú ya sabes… you already know…
Spanish y English make the whole world flow!
¡Acción! ¡Reacción! ¡Educación! ¡Celebración!
You already speak both – ¡eso es la verdad!
Tú ya sabes… tú ya sabes… you already know!

[Production note for Suno: build energy with each chorus, add crowd cheers on final chorus, end with big drop and bilingual chant]
